## Buildx and BuildKit

Buildx is the CLI interface to BuildKit. In PyWhales,
[`docker.build()`](buildx.md#build), `docker.image.build()`, and
`docker.buildx.build()` all call `docker buildx build` directly.

Use `progress="plain"` or `progress="quiet"` to control build output. For a locally
loaded image, use `load=True` with `tags`, for example
`docker.build(".", load=True, tags="app:local")`. Normal blocking builds return
`Image | None`: an `Image` when the build result is loaded into the Docker daemon,
or `None` for push-only and other non-loading exports.

## Current controls and return values

`build(call="check")`, `build(call="outline")`, and `build(call="targets")`
return captured frontend report text without trying to recover an image.
`call="build"` retains normal image-building behavior. Leaving `call` unset
preserves the existing `Image | None` return contract. Streaming still returns
an owned output stream. Reports can require a builder and frontend metadata;
they are not a guarantee of offline or daemon-free execution.

`build(no_cache_filter=["dependencies"])` bypasses cache for named Dockerfile
stages. `annotations=["index:org.opencontainers.image.description=Example"]`
adds exporter annotations, which differ from image configuration `labels`.
Support depends on the installed Buildx, frontend, and exporter.

`bake()` keeps its default configuration return: one build command followed by
one `--print` query. `bake(return_config=False)` skips the extra query and
returns `None`; it does not change the build itself. `bake(print=True)` is a
single config-only command. Combining print with streaming, a report call, or
`return_config=False` is invalid. Bake also accepts the report `call` modes
and `jobs` for target scheduling. Bake jobs do not set Compose Engine-call
parallelism or BuildKit's internal step parallelism.

External cache support is not limited to `docker-container`. It depends on
the driver, backend, and image store. The `docker` driver supports the
documented external backends when the containerd image store is enabled.
See [Build performance and measurement](../user_guide/build_performance.md)
for cache, security, output-store limitations, and reproducible measurements.
